entities.summary: Kevin Gerard Simms is an English former rugby union footballer; he gained 15 caps for England as a centre between 1985 and 1988. He played in the 1987 Rugby World Cup. He played club rugby for Liverpool St Helens and Wasps. During his career he captained the North of England against South Africa at Elland Road and the All Blacks at Anfield. He is now a GP in Liverpool.
